summary: Survey the inherited workspace (pilot only): list files, check pilot.csv shape/header, check uv and sklearn, never touch data/heldout.csv
reasoning: The route's design (a logistic regression tuned on pilot alone) needs the pilot size, class balance and library versions before I can size a grid honestly. The inherited analysis.py already gates the held-out file behind --final, so a pilot-only run never opens it. Baseline cv_auc 0.6313 is established by probe:synth-r1-pairs@sha256:8077a7099ae1ee41c19b09eb0444a873eedfb0a2c06a15cf8d4e9dd6d2992f87#step-9 (cited by the task). I build my design on the provisional kernel-logistic result of probe:synth-r2-logistic@sha256:386e59ef5a981294198bd6eaac9cdf53ddb0390aeae00d017423c7bb3bf4919d#step-19 (cv_auc 0.8678): it shows a plain L2 logistic on the twelve features as given cannot express this dataset's interactions (so the route's logistic needs a kernel expansion of those same features), and that such a model reached ~0.87 cv on this pilot. I will verify independently with my own grid, chosen only on pilot data.
